parameters.name: AdaptiveRouting
parameters.description: The cross-origin address pool back-to-origin configuration.

parameters.name: DefaultPools
parameters.description: The list of default address pool IDs.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the load balancer for management and identification purposes.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the load balancer is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

parameters.name: FallbackPool
parameters.description: The fallback address pool ID. Traffic is directed to this pool when all other pools are unavailable.

parameters.name: Monitor
parameters.description: The monitor configuration for health checks.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the load balancer. The name must be in a valid domain name format and must be a subdomain of the site.

parameters.name: RandomSteering
parameters.description: The weighted round-robin configuration that controls the traffic distribution weight across different address pools.

parameters.name: RegionPools
parameters.description: The address pools mapped to primary regions.

sub_parameters.name: FixedResponse
sub_parameters.description: The fixed response content returned after a rule is matched.

sub_parameters.name: Overrides
sub_parameters.description: The load balancing configuration that overwrites the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration when a rule is matched. The specified fields overwrite the corresponding fields in the load balancer configuration.

sub_parameters.name: Rule
sub_parameters.description:
The rule content that uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
- Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
- Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq \"video.example.com\").

sub_parameters.name: RuleEnable
sub_parameters.description:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
- on: Enabled.
- off: Disabled.

sub_parameters.name: RuleName
sub_parameters.description: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration.

sub_parameters.name: Sequence
sub_parameters.description: The rule execution order. This parameter is optional. If not specified, rules are executed in list order. If specified, the value must be a positive integer. A larger value indicates a higher priority.

sub_parameters.name: Terminates
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to stop executing subsequent rules. Valid values:

- true: Stop executing subsequent rules.
- false: Continue executing subsequent rules. This is the default value.

parameters.name: SessionAffinity
parameters.description:
The session persistence mode. Valid values:
- off: disabled.
- ip: IP-based session persistence.
- cookie: cookie-based session persistence.
- http_header: HTTP header-based session persistence.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SteeringPolicy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy. Valid values:

- geo: geo-based routing.
- random: weighted round-robin.
- order: primary/secondary mode.

parameters.name: SubRegionPools
parameters.description: The address pools mapped to secondary regions. If multiple secondary regions share the same set of address pools, you can concatenate the secondary region names with commas as the key.

parameters.name: Ttl
parameters.description: The TTL value, which specifies the time-to-live of the DNS record. Default value: 30 seconds. Valid values: 10 to 600.
